summary.collateral_ratio_basis: System-wide measured-leg reserve / ALL Mento stablecoin debt. NOT USDm's own coverage. See backing.collateral_ratio for the rated figure and backing.alternatives for the other denominators.
summary.surplus_deficit_basis: Measured-leg gross reserve minus all Mento stablecoin debt.

peg.market_price_as_of_basis: Observation time of the Mento getAmountOut quote, carried on the peg-tracker snapshot entry this mark is read from. Dates the MARK, not this analyzer's run.
peg.market_price_self_referential_basis: Mento getAmountOut, the same venue and the same quote that liquidity.exit_mark uses as fair_value. Dated and external to THIS analyzer, but not independent of the venue being measured. A CoinGecko or routed aggregate mark would dissolve it; the Celo aggregate is a candidate but is a different chain's price and is not wired as a cross-check.

liquidity.total_2pct_depth_note: No executable ladder is quoted for USDm. Depth is unmeasured, not zero, and Mento pool balances are not substituted for it. TO ESTABLISH IT: DexTracker already exports an on-chain getAmountOut ladder for the Monad USDm/USDC FPMM (1k/10k/50k/100k), and this analyzer already reads it for the peg mark. The open question is not access but DEFINITION — an oracle-priced FPMM quote is flat across sizes by construction, so it measures the mint/redeem venue's willingness to quote rather than secondary-market depth, and publishing it as total_2pct_depth would compare unlike things against every other asset on the board.

primary_exit.gated_note: Any address may call swap() on the Monad FPMMs — the probe reverts on economics, not permission. The Celo Reserve's own mint/redeem is a SEPARATE venue and is allowlisted to strategies; this field describes the FPMM only.
primary_exit.flow_limits_note: Per-pool trading limits, in USDm units per configured window. Being open to any address does not make the exit unbounded.

liquidity.pools_note: Mento swap pools are a mint/redeem venue rather than secondary market depth; pool balances are reported under asset_specific.

backing.collateral_ratio_basis: Stable-only reserve / all Mento stablecoin debt. Stable-only excludes the volatile bucket, which is largely CELO — Mento's own ecosystem token, so it is collateral correlated with its issuer. The denominator is all Mento debt because the reserve backs every Mento stable jointly.
backing.surplus_deficit_basis: Stable-only reserve minus all Mento stablecoin debt — the SAME basis as collateral_ratio, so B/(B - surplus_deficit) recovers it. ⚠️ NOT the gross figure, which is a +$3.4M SURPLUS against this deficit because it counts the volatile bucket; that one is in alternatives.gross_surplus_deficit_usd.

alternatives.note: Published so the rated figure is auditable against the ones not chosen. ⚠️ reserve_to_supply_ratio* denominators are TOTAL MENTO stablecoin supply, not USDm's — the field names do not say so.

volatile_bucket.drawdown_to_par_basis: 1 - (mento_debt - stable_only_reserve) / volatile_bucket: the haircut on the volatile bucket at which stable-only coverage reaches 100%. ⚠️ Independent of which mark is headlined, which is what makes it the informative figure rather than either ratio.
volatile_bucket.note: Excluded from the rated ratio. Correlated with the issuer, so it is the part of the reserve least likely to be there in the scenario the backing score exists to warn about.

upstream.name: Volatile bucket (largely CELO)
upstream.note: ⚠️ Correlated with the issuer — CELO is Mento's own ecosystem token. Excluded from the rated collateral ratio.

dependencies.is_partition_basis: The displayed percentages sum to 114%, but they use two denominators and are not one partition: asset rows partition the Monad-only reserve subtotal, while the volatile bucket is measured against the all-chain total reserve.
dependencies.note: USDm's dependencies are the assets in the Mento reserve. The Monad breakdown is shown in full and partitions only the Monad subtotal. The volatile bucket uses the all-chain total reserve denominator and is listed separately because it is excluded from the rated ratio. The combined rows are not one partition and must not be summed.

aggregate.reserve_source_basis: on-chain sweep (ethereum) + on-chain ReserveV2 (monad) + API (other legs)
aggregate.stablecoin_aggregate_ratio_basis: measured-leg gross reserve / all Mento stablecoin debt
aggregate.stablecoin_aggregate_ratio_stable_only_b: measured-leg stable-only reserve / all Mento stablecoin debt
aggregate.reserve_to_supply_ratio_stable_only_basi: measured-leg stable-only reserve / all Mento stablecoin supply

backing.basis: Anchored on the published risk report's own trigger levels: 102 restore, 100 par, 98 the cut trigger, 90 severe. The 98 line is the threshold the report itself uses, so the axis and the report agree on the boundary rather than each carrying its own.
backing.overrides_reason: usdm.js sets chart_bands for chart legibility (y-range 90-130) and backingRating honours them as a rating scale; its critical:[0,98] collapses 91.02 into the worst band. An explicit cr_pct wins and leaves the chart untouched.
backing.expires_reason: Anchored on par and a published policy trigger, neither of which drifts. Contrast USG, whose floor is a debt-weighted mean over a changing market set and therefore does expire.
